name: infer-conventions
tagline_zh: 别再争论 Form Request 还是内联校验——它扫一遍真实代码，把实际用的模式写成 .ai/rules。
tagline_en: Stop debating Form Requests vs inline validation—it scans real code, writes actual patterns into .ai/rules, so.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 不是从文档猜，而是从提交历史里挖出真实约定；能识别混合风格并给出冲突报告，让规则跟着代码走。
why_en: Infers from actual commits, not docs; detects mixed patterns and flags conflicts, so rules evolve with code, not vibes.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel 项目（需有 composer.json 和 app/ 目录）；只分析 PHP 代码。
limit_en: Laravel-only (needs composer.json & app/); analyzes PHP only, ignores frontend/migrations; outputs rules text, doesn't modify code.
